mentions.name: KartInsightsPro
mentions.description: A kart data analysis and video synchronizer that helps users understand the large amount of data generated by kart data loggers such as Mychron and UniGo. Written in CHICKEN Scheme with FFI bindings.
mentions.problem: Data loggers like Mychron and UniGo generate a ton of data that is hard to actually understand.
mentions.audience: Kart racers using data loggers like Mychron and UniGo
mentions.source_excerpt: * A kart data analysis & video synchronizer, that helps you actually understand the ton of data that data loggers like Mychron and UniGo generate https://kartinsightspro.app - written in CHICKEN scheme with tons of FFI bindings
